aggregation: mean over 20 cases of mean over 40 measurements of maximum rank wall time; milliseconds

modes.normal: P2P KV/dKV ring transfers overlapped with the original per-step attention, O/LSE combination, and FP32 gradient accumulation.
modes.compute-only: KV ready before timing; no timed KV/dKV transfers; the original step partitioning and local operations remain.
modes.one-step: KV prefixes ready before timing; per sample, both zigzag Q halves and their respective KV prefixes are packed into one varlen FA3 call; overlapping-prefix dKV contributions are combined.

timing: Complete forward_all or backward_all, including Python dispatch, kernels, local combination, mode-specific communication, and inter-group world barriers; setup, KV prefetch/packing, gradient buffer resets, and pre-phase synchronization are excluded.
